video_title: Washburn: Jaylen Brown-Paul George Trade is a DISASTER for Celtics | Big 3 NBA Podcast

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' limited financial flexibility after signing Kristaps Porzingis and Mike Conley
quotes.excerpt: using the mid-level to sign Kristaps Porzingis, which means they're hard capped at the first apron
quotes.quote: It would be natural to think that the Celtics have this $27.7 million trade exception they can use to get a really quality player to add to their free agency now that they've signed Kristaps Porzingis and Mike Conley. But using the mid-level to sign Kristaps Porzingis, which means they're hard capped at the first apron, which means they only have about $5 million available for free agency unless they shed salary. Now they can cut corners, Delano Banton, if they really wanted to get rid of someone like Jordan Walsh. So they can do $2-3 million here, $2-3 million there, to create $11 or $12 million or something like that, but it's not going to be $27.7 million.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson's three-year, $47.4 million contract is a great deal for Boston
quotes.excerpt: for the Celtics to get him at three years $47.4 million is a great, great, great deal
quotes.quote: Pleasantly surprised because I thought he was going to be able to get more money. I thought when you look at what he does defensively, his offensive rebounding ability, the fact that damn near any and every time he's on the floor, good things happen, no matter who else is on the floor. Even when they're not making shots, good things found a way of happening when he was on the floor in New York. I thought a guy like that was going to be closer to $20 million. So for the Celtics to get him at three years $47.4 million is a great, great, great deal for Boston.

quotes.speaker: A. Sherrod Blakely
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson makes the Celtics a deeper team by moving their starting center to the bench
quotes.excerpt: This guy makes you a deeper team because now your starting center for your 50-ish win team
quotes.quote: This guy makes you a deeper team because now your starting center for your 50-ish win team is now your backup center. And your starting center now will probably be Mitchell Robinson, a guy who just won a championship and had some of the biggest plays in that run towards that championship for that New York Knicks team. So there's a lot of positive things that you can take away from him.

quotes.speaker: A. Sherrod Blakely
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson's defensive impact on pick-and-roll coverage
quotes.excerpt: The key element of Mitchell Robinson's game is defending guards on the pick-and-roll.
quotes.quote: The key element of Mitchell Robinson's game is defending guards on the pick-and-roll. You can't get past him. He can guard anybody on the pick-and-roll. Even though he's got a lanky frame about him, long arms, he's not this freakish athlete, his technique, his footwork, his skill set allows him to guard anybody on the pick-and-roll to where you just can't drive past him and get to the rack. I mean, I'm not talking about he's going to keep up constantly with Tyrese Maxey, but he'll provide more resistance for Tyrese Maxey off the pick-and-roll and some of the quicker guards in the league.

quotes.speaker: A. Sherrod Blakely
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Mitchell Robinson's offensive rebounding to Andre Drummond
quotes.excerpt: Andre Drummond is a great rebounder. Mitchell Robinson might be better in terms of his ability
quotes.quote: Andre Drummond is a great rebounder. Mitchell Robinson might be better in terms of his ability to get offensive rebounds, tip the ball, three guys around him from the other team, well, I got it, boom, and then the free throw shooting I think that's something that obviously the Celtics are going to have to figure out.

quotes.speaker: A. Sherrod Blakely
quotes.summary_phrase: The Jaylen Brown-Paul George trade is a major blunder for the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: If you are literally going to trade Jaylen for prospects and picks, you ain't trying to win
quotes.quote: If you are literally going to trade Jaylen for prospects and picks, you ain't trying to win next year. But these two moves, you're trying to win next year. So what are we doing, man? What are we doing, man? I feel like Chris Tucker, hey man, come on man, what are you doing, man?

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: The Jaylen Brown trade is a disaster for the Brad Stevens era
quotes.excerpt: This is the biggest blunder in the era of Brad Stevens
quotes.quote: To me, this is the biggest blunder in the era of Brad Stevens. This has been terribly handled because you're dragging a player who doesn't deserve to be dragged. You're shopping him. What do you feel like you're going to get? Because now I just read the Athletic report that Portland was not all that ever all that interested in Jaylen. Okay, so now Portland's out. So Cleveland, what team are you going to trade him to? And what are you going to get back in return? And is that return help you win next year?

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' roster needs and the potential for Mitchell Robinson to contribute
quotes.excerpt: can Mitchell Robinson come in and play 9, 10, 12 minutes a game on this level defensively?
quotes.quote: Can Mitchell Robinson come in and play 9, 10, 12 minutes a game on this level defensively? Is he already an NBA defender? Probably so. The Jaylen thing is hovering, and then the market still has to shake out to where there's somebody, it's like musical chairs, somebody ain't getting paid, who's expecting right now to get paid. That's why these guys are taking these deals.

quotes.speaker: A. Sherrod Blakely
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics' failed pursuit of Giannis Antetokounmpo led to the Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: Initially they went into this thinking we're going to get Giannis, we're going to get Giannis
quotes.quote: Initially they went into this thinking we're going to get Giannis, we're going to get Giannis because no one is going to offer a better player in the deal than we will, which is true. But Milwaukee was just like, yeah, we want a really good player, but we also want draft picks, we also want capital, we want to build the roster. And so the Celtics then had to pivot. And they were like, okay, well if we're not going to get Giannis, we're going to wind up losing the deal because we're giving away the best player, who by the way is 29 years old and has been with us for 10 years.

quotes.speaker: A. Sherrod Blakely
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's Hall of Fame trajectory and why trading him makes no sense
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen is going into the freaking Hall of Fame. He's already put together a Hall of Fame resume
quotes.quote: Jaylen is going into the freaking Hall of Fame. He's already put together a Hall of Fame resume and he hasn't even hit his 30th birthday yet. And if you're going to move on from a player like that, you damn well better ask for the world. You better ask for the world, the moon, and a couple constellations outside, because he is that type of player. His value should be that. And if you can't get that and no one's going to offer you that, guess what? Rent.
